description: arXiv:2605.09159v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) encode behavioral traits ("personas") as linear directions in activation space, often called "persona vectors". Prior work has used such directions as static handles for behavioral steering. We instead treat them as dynamic signals: probes we can monitor and intervene on as reasoning unfolds....
author: Nils A. Herrmann, Leander Girrbach, Kirill Bykov, Zeynep Akata
